overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Growth 2x Daily ETF (USGX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund uses swap agreements and other financial instruments to pursue 2x leveraged exposure to the daily performance of the Vanguard Growth ETF (VUG), before fees and expenses. The fund does not aim to achieve 2x of the underlying ETF for any period other than a single day. USGX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
